Available September 2022 · Two Bedrooms · Great Location

Acorn Properties would like to welcome to the market this 2 Bedroom furnished apartment in Killingworth Hall, Killingworth village. It has been recently renovated and has a number of original features, property has secure off road parking, visitor parking and overlooks private landscaped grounds. The property also benefits from an alarm and gas central heating. To arrange your viewing call Acorn Properties Today on 0191 212 2020 and speak to the Lettings Team
